statement: ∀ (f : WaveMap.Space n → ℝ) (Q : Set (WaveMap.Space n)) (K : ℝ), (∀ x ∈ Q, ‖f x‖ ≤ K) → ∀ x ∈ Q, |f x| ≤ max K 0
proof:
intro f Q K h x hx
have hb : |f x| ≤ K := by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using h x hx
exact hb.trans (le_max_left _ _)
